description:
What is Cora Network?
 Cora is a fun and enjoyable server for all the PvP and Skillful players.We also offer an amazing and innovative OPFactions, and Practice experience.
 
 We currently have Asia, and NA (soon) regions for Practice!

How to join Cora?
 1. Click PLAY it will open your Minecraft.
 2. Press Play then Press Server.
 3. Find Cora on your server list.
 4. Press Join server.
